args.title: Material PR Technical RFQ Split Award

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule; the exact evaluation duration is not configurable by this step.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors without inventing supplier names.

args.goal: On the buyer create screen, add one Required T&C clause and stop with the clause visibly saved in the event terms.

steps.note: Add the required T&C clause, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Publish the completed Technical + RFQ event.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Have the first invited vendor answer the Technical stage and submit a quote of 100.
Confirm the first vendor's submission was accepted.
Have the second invited vendor answer the Technical stage and submit a quote of 90.
Confirm the second vendor's submission was accepted.
Wait for the bidding window to end before evaluation and awarding.
Score and submit the vendor technical responses after the Technical stage closes.
Open the buyer comparison grid after bidding and evaluation.
Verify ranks follow the quoted amounts and that the lower quote ranks first.
The second bidder in this plan represents Vendor B and should be Rank 1.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed event.
Allocate six units of the line to the lower-priced second vendor.
Allocate the remaining four units to the first vendor.
Verify the split selected both vendors and totals 6×90 plus 4×100.
Create the award proposal from the completed split allocation.
Confirm the proposal screen exposes its submission control.
Submit the split award proposal.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete the approved award flow and create the purchase orders.
Confirm PO records contain two awarded PO lines across the created orders.
Return to the events list to verify the event entered history.
Open the History tab.
Confirm this plan's event appears in event history.
